   **Bugs and stability.**
      4 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 15, 2026 - Sep 16, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Jim Steenbergen_, Sep 16, 2026, 1/5: "Having the same issues as Kimberly on 6/15. Every time I have to update phone the sync gets messed up and I have to leave on charger and start using my "fitbit charge 2" watch, which is much more reliable. Plus it no longer reads my O2 or EKG. only one light on back lights up, where there use to be 3 lights!!!"
            2. _Allison 'AJ' John_, Sep 16, 2026, 1/5: "Consistently stuck, never syncs. WORST Google app and I'm a big Google fan. They never should have shut down Fitbit until it was ready. This one is a glitchy joke."
            3. _Lorraine P_, Jul 15, 2026, 1/5: "Nouvelle interface Google Health, j'ai lu les commentaires de 1 étoile et je suis entièrement d'accord...je donnerais un -5 si je pouvais. Une montre qui ne sert qu'à dire l'heure et l'IA qui sert absolument à rien, pourquoi changer quelque chose qui fonctionnait bien...comme on dit en anglais...if it ain't broken, why fix it. Sommeil est complètement faux... installe - désinstalle - installe - désinstalle ...que de frustrations...impossible de me connecter ce matin."
